mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.intro, u.polygon_json, fr.public_url AS image_url FROM university u LEFT JOIN university_file_relation ufr ON ufr.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN file_resource fr ON fr.id = ufr.file_resource_id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fr.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE u.status = 'ENABLED' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY u.id ASC, ufr.sort_no ASC, ufr.file_resource_id ASC
